'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[War crimes in the Syrian civil war]], [[Fall of the Assad regime]]
***[[Syrian mass graves]]
****Several [[Mass grave|mass graves]] are uncovered across [[Syria]] following the fall of the Assad regime, with a site in [[Al-Qutayfah]], [[Rif Dimashq Governorate]], estimated to contain the remains of at least 100,000 people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/least-100000-bodies-syrian-mass-grave-us-advocacy-group-head-says-2024-12-17/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/gallery/2024/12/17/thousands-of-bodies-found-in-syrias-mass-graves (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Israeli invasion of Syria (2024–present)]]
***[[Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] and [[Minister of Defense (Israel)|Defense Minister]] [[Israel Katz]] visit the summit of [[Mount Hermon]] in Syria, which was captured by the [[Israel Defense Forces]] last week. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/12/17/world/middleeast/17syria-israel-netanyahu.html (''The New York Times'')]
***The Israeli military continue invading Syria beyond the [[Agreement on Disengagement between Israel and Syria|1974 buffer zone]] in [[Quneitra Governorate]] and take control of the [[Al-Wehda Dam]] on the [[Yarmouk River]]. [https://www.jfeed.com/news-israel/son5ct (JFeed)]
**[[Operation Dawn of Freedom]]
***Senior [[United States|American]] officials report that [[Turkey]] is building up [[Turkish Armed Forces|its forces]] along the [[Syria–Turkey border|Syrian border]], raising fears of a possible ground invasion on territories held by the [[Kurds in Syria|Kurdish]]-led [[Syrian Democratic Forces]]. [https://www.wsj.com/world/middle-east/u-s-fears-military-buildup-by-turkey-signals-preparations-for-incursion-into-syria-1c2e88e9 (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russia]]n Lieutenant General [[Igor Kirillov (general)|Igor Kirillov]], head of the [[Russian NBC Protection Troops|NBC Protection Troops]], and his assistant are [[Assassination|assassinated]] by an [[Improvised explosive device|IED]] hidden inside of an [[e-scooter]] in [[Moscow]], Russia. A [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] source claims that the [[Security Service of Ukraine]] is responsible for the killings, after Kirillov was charged ''in absentia'' yesterday for the use of [[chemical weapon]]s, which made him a "legitimate target". [[Dmitry Medvedev]], deputy chairman of the [[Security Council of Russia]], says that the Ukrainian leadership would face an "imminent revenge" for the killings. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cm2ek388yxzo (BBC News)] [https://www.deccanherald.com/world/russias-medvedev-says-kyiv-will-face-imminent-revenge-for-killing-of-russian-general-ria-3321059 (''Deccan Herald'')]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]], [[Russia–NATO relations]]
***[[NATO]]'s [[NATO Security Assistance and Training for Ukraine|Security Assistance and Training for Ukraine]] [[command center]] in [[Wiesbaden]], [[Germany]], takes over coordination of Western military support to [[Ukraine]] from the [[United States]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/nato-takes-over-coordination-military-aid-kyiv-us-source-says-2024-12-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Two police officers are killed and three others are injured in a mass shooting at a security checkpoint in [[Shangla district]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-militant-attack-police-post-restive-northwest-bf94bbd80b1b69238cf9d16709afb61c (AP)]
**Three police officers are killed and two more are wounded by a roadside bomb targeting a vehicle carrying [[polio]] [[Polio vaccine|vaccination workers]] in [[Dera Ismail Khan District]], Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/roadside-bomb-kills-3-police-officers-escorting-polio-116881644 (ABC News)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Two municipal policemen are killed  and three civilians are wounded in an attack near the Jerécuaro-[[Apaseo el Alto]] state highway in [[Jerécuaro]], [[Guanajuato]], [[Mexico]]. In the same day, four [[Secretariat of Public Security|State Public Security Forces]] officers are killed and two more are wounded after a confrontation with gunmen in the city of [[Uriangato]].  [https://www.milenio.com/politica/comunidad/policias-asesinados-en-jerecuaro-matan-a-dos-elementos (''Milenio'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024–25 South-West Indian Ocean cyclone season]]
**The death toll in [[Mozambique]] from [[Cyclone Chido]] increase to 34, with more than 23,000 homes destroyed. [https://www.dw.com/en/cyclone-chido-kills-34-in-mozambique-after-battering-mayotte/a-71080308 (DW)]
*[[2024 Port Vila earthquake]]
**A 7.4 magnitude [[List of earthquakes in Vanuatu|earthquake]] strikes [[Vanuatu]]'s capital [[Port Vila]], with at least fourteen people killed and more than 200 others injured. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/national/536941/live-large-7-point-3-magnitude-earthquake-strikes-near-vanuatu (RNZ)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2024 Kwango province malaria outbreak]]
**The [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]'s Health Ministry announces that the mystery illness that has left at least 143 people dead in [[Kwango]] was a severe form of [[malaria]]. The [[World Health Organization]] says more [[malaria vaccine]]s are being sent to its health centres in the region. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/dec/17/drc-health-ministry-says-mystery-disease-is-severe-form-of-malaria (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Northeastern United States drone sightings]]
**The U.S. [[United States House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence|House Intelligence Committee]] hold a closed-door [[Classified information in the United States|classified briefing]] on drone sightings over the [[Northeastern United States]]. The briefing is provided by [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]], the [[Central Intelligence Agency|CIA]] and the [[Director of National Intelligence|Office of the Director of National Intelligence]], according to senior U.S. officials. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/video/house-intelligence-committee-holds-classified-briefing-drone-sightings-116884129 (ABC News)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/white-house/white-house-presses-congress-provide-authority-address-drones-us-airsp-rcna184491 (NBC News)]
*[[Killing of Brian Thompson]]
**A [[Juries in the United States|U.S. grand jury]] indicts [[Luigi Mangione]] for [[Killing of Brian Thompson|the assassination]] of [[UnitedHealthcare]] [[Chief executive officer|CEO]] [[Brian Thompson (businessman)|Brian Thompson]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/luigi-mangione-indicted-first-degree-murder-charge-grand-jury-unitedhe-rcna184313 (NBC News)]
*[[Mexican Drug War]]
**Three foreigners are arrested and one ton of cocaine is seized by the [[Mexican Navy]] in an operation off coasts of [[Lázaro Cárdenas, Michoacán]]. [https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/caen-tres-extranjeros-con-una-tonelada-de-cocaina-en-michoacan-navegaban-en-costas-de-lazaro-cardenas/ (''El Universal'')]
*[[Murder of Sara Sharif]]
**[[High Court judge (England and Wales)|English High Court judge]] [[John Cavanagh (judge)|John Cavanagh]] sentences Urfan Sharif and Beinash Batool to [[Life imprisonment in England and Wales|life imprisonment]] for the [[Murder in English law|murder]] of Sharif's 10-year-old daughter Sara. [https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/world/2024/12/17/father-stepmother-of-murdered-uk-pakistani-girl-jailed-for-life-2326 (ABS-CBN News)]
*Canadian-American [[anti-whaling]] activist [[Paul Watson]] is released from [[Law enforcement in Greenland#Prison system|prison]] in [[Greenland]] after [[Denmark]] declines [[Japan]]'s [[extradition]] request. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/17/antiwhaling-activist-paul-watson-released-as-denmark-rejects-extradition (Al Jazeera)]
